hourly.summary: Arsenal fans are absolutely buzzing with academy pride and transfer optimism - Max Dowman's record-breaking exploits have the fanbase giddy about 'internal solutions', while the Kroupi bandwagon is at full capacity with supporters convinced he'll choose North London over Manchester. Timber's contract situation is praised as 'seriously smart business', and even international breaks bring joy as Timber and Havertz get minutes. The vibe is pure 'we're building something special' energy with a side of 'Bellingham better watch his back for Dowman' banter.

daily.summary: Arsenal fan sentiment surged dramatically throughout the day, rising from a buoyant morning (8/10) fueled by strong team metrics and transfer optimism, through a cautiously hopeful midday (7/10) centered on Declan Rice's contract talks amid fixture anxiety, to outright euphoria (10/10) by evening as Arsenal players starred in England's World Cup final victory. The through-line is Rice — thriving at club and country — anchoring a day that ended in peak 'Arsenal won the World Cup' delirium.

weekly.summary: Arsenal fan sentiment traced a dramatic upward arc across the week, shifting from early anxiety over transfers, refereeing, and injury fears (5/10) through a measured, resilient midweek phase to a late-week surge of unity and triumph. The turning point arrived with collective solidarity for Arseblog's Andrew Mangan, followed by contract optimism and youth breakthroughs, culminating in euphoric delirium as Arsenal players starred in England's World Cup final victory. The week exemplifies the fanbase's volatility — oscillating between neuroses and peak joy — but finishes on a definitive high.\n
